title: FanDuel首席执行官谈体育竞猜市场热度
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Hi everyone. Thank you so much for being here.
segments.zh: 大家好，非常感谢各位到场。

segments.en: I'm so excited to sit down with Christian.
segments.zh: 我很期待与克里斯蒂安的对话。

segments.en: It's the start of a new NFL season. Did we all watch the game last night?
segments.zh: 新赛季NFL开始了，昨晚的比赛大家都看了吗？

segments.en: Yeah, okay. Seahawks blanking the paths.
And of course tonight the 49ers in Melbourne. How nutty the time of the year is this for you?
segments.zh: 今晚49人队在墨尔本。这个时间点对你来说有多忙？

segments.en: Or has a hard work been done and you just kind of sit back and see it all play out?
segments.zh: 还是说最忙的时候已经过去，你只需坐等一切展开？

segments.en: Oh, I'd love to say I was sitting back and just enjoying watching play out.
segments.zh: 我倒想说我在坐等欣赏一切展开。

segments.en: Oh, look, I'm a big sports fan myself. So this is my favorite time of year when we get to football kicking off and it's fun.
segments.zh: 我也是个超级体育迷。这是一年中最喜欢的时节，橄榄球开赛了，很有趣。

segments.en: In the position I have, we get a lot of advanced information about how fans are feeling seeing what they're betting on futures and that sort of thing.
segments.zh: 以我的职位，我们能获得很多关于粉丝情绪的前沿信息，看到他们押注什么未来走势等等。

segments.en: But we've done all the hard work. We know we've done the parts we can control, but we still hold our breath when we go into the first night to see.
segments.zh: 但我们已经做了所有能做的，控制好我们能控制的部分，但第一晚来临时我们仍会屏息以待。

segments.en: It's the time of year when so many of our customers come back.
segments.zh: 每年这个时候，很多用户都会回来。

segments.en: Football is our biggest sport. So thankfully they did all come back.
segments.zh: 橄榄球是我们最大的体育项目。还好他们都回来了。

segments.en: We had more users bet on last night's game than any regular season NFL game in the history of our business.
segments.zh: 昨晚比赛的投注用户数，超过我们历史上任何一场NFL常规赛。

segments.en: So that was great to see. You yourself are a college football fan.
segments.zh: 这非常令人振奋。你本人也是大学橄榄球迷。

segments.en: Yes. Alabama. What does the volume look like for college football versus pro football?
segments.zh: 是的，阿拉巴马大学。大学橄榄球和职业橄榄球的投注量相比如何？

segments.en: So pro football is considerably bigger. And if you add up all the volume of all the games, there's a lot more college football games in a calendar than there are NFL.
segments.zh: 职业橄榄球要大得多。如果把所有比赛的量加起来，大学橄榄球一年中的比赛场次比NFL多很多。

segments.en: NFL sort of famously celebrates the scarcity of it.
And that's what makes it so special. But we definitely, we have more customers who bet on the NFL than any other sport.
segments.zh: 这正是它特别之处。但我们的NFL投注用户确实比其他任何体育项目都多。

segments.en: And it's our biggest activation time of the year as well.
segments.zh: 这也是我们一年中最大的激活时段。
